commands.short_help: Pattern-based bug detection in .cpp/.h source files.
commands.notes: Pattern tabanli; Blueprint ozel detector bolumu placeholder.

commands.short_help: Convert natural language to CLI commands using NLP parser.
commands.notes: Intent mapping komut gercegiyle driftli (or. `build project`, `blueprint list`).

commands.short_help: List and review Git pull requests.
commands.notes: GitHub/GitLab entegrasyonu kisitli; bazi provider metodlari placeholder donuyor.

commands.short_help: Find and report duplicate assets by name or content hash.
commands.notes: Tespit yapar ama extension listesinde bosluklu girdiler (`. tga`, `. flac`) var.

commands.short_help: Organize assets into proper directory structure based on file types.
commands.notes: Dosya tasir (destructive). Extension listesinde bosluklu patternler var (`. dae`, `. mkv`).

commands.short_help: Scan directory for Unreal Engine assets and provide a detailed report.
commands.notes: Heuristic siniflama yapar; cp1254 ortaminda gorsel cikti kaynakli risk mevcut.

commands.short_help: Auto-fix common project issues.
commands.notes: Gercek dosya degisikligi yapabilir; kapsamli guvenlik siniri/allowlist yok.

commands.short_help: Analyze and organize misplaced assets.
commands.notes: Smart organizer output key fallback applied; still experimental.

commands.short_help: Create a smart backup of the project.
commands.notes: Snapshot kopyasi alir; dry-run yok, buyuk projelerde maliyet yuksek.

commands.short_help: List available backups.
commands.notes: Basit klasor patterniyle listeler (`_backup_`), metadata modeli sinirli.

commands.short_help: Restore a backup.
commands.notes: `copytree` ile toplu overwrite yapabilir; rollback yok.

commands.short_help: Analyze Blueprint files and show complexity statistics.
commands.notes: .uasset binary icinden UTF-8 heuristic parse ile metrik cikarimi yapiyor.

commands.short_help: Generate a detailed complexity report for all Blueprints
commands.notes: Raporlama var ama complexity verisi heuristic; HTML cikti path/format kontrolleri kisitli.

commands.short_help: Generate CI/CD pipeline configuration.
commands.notes: CI dosyasi uretir; `--dry-run` preview ve `--force` overwrite guard var, ama UE path/version hala hardcoded (`UE_5.3`).

commands.short_help: Generate optimized Dockerfile for Unreal Engine.
commands.notes: Dockerfile uretir; `--dry-run` preview ve `--force` overwrite guard var, ama `ProjectName` placeholder hala manuel guncelleme istiyor.

commands.short_help: Show build information and recommendations.
commands.notes: .uproject metadata okur; build pipeline durumunu dogrudan denetlemez.

commands.short_help: Show team dashboard summary.
commands.notes: Takim metrikleri heuristik/default agirlikli; role/platform/config varsayimlari sabit.

commands.short_help: Share project templates.
commands.notes: CLI lokal zip export yapiyor; gercek remote share akisinda mock implementation mevcut.

commands.short_help: Opens .unrealmate.toml in the system default editor.
commands.notes: Yerel `.unrealmate.toml` dosyasini varsayilan editor ile acmayi dener; editor launch davranisi platform bagimli kalir.

commands.short_help: Get a configuration value.
commands.notes: Basit dot-notation okur; olmayan key icin `None` dondurur.

commands.short_help: Initialize .unrealmate.toml configuration file.
commands.notes: Fonksiyonel olarak config olusturuyor; cp1254 terminalde spinner/emoji ciktilari kiriyor.

commands.short_help: Set a configuration value.
commands.notes: Yalnizca `section.key` formatini destekliyor; nested key/unknown section desteklenmiyor.

commands.short_help: Show current configuration.
commands.notes: Cikti guvenilir, ancak komut akisinda Unicode gorsel katman riski var.

commands.short_help: Apply a performance preset template to .unrealmate.toml.
commands.notes: Hardcoded preset uygular; `--dry-run` preview vardir, [performance] section overwrite eder ve rollback snapshot olusturmaz.

commands.short_help: Validates .unrealmate.toml structure and values.
commands.notes: Temel schema dogrular; kapsamli schema/migration dogrulamasi yok.

commands.short_help: Clean build artifacts, intermediate files, and temporary data.
commands.notes: Destructive islem; `--dry-run` var ama varsayilan akista klasor siler.

commands.short_help: Initialize git configuration with optimized settings for Unreal Engine.
commands.notes: Template patternlerinde bosluk bozuklugu var (`*. sln`, `*. ini. bak`).

commands.short_help: Setup Git LFS used for large binary files (assets, maps, etc).
commands.notes: LFS template patternlerinde bosluk bozuklugu var (`*. uasset`, `*. exe`).

commands.short_help: Check for updates for installed assets.
commands.notes: Guncelleme kontrolu simule edilir; launcher yonlendirmesi informational.

commands.short_help: Export list of marketplace assets.
commands.notes: Export calisir ama kaynak veri mock DB.

commands.short_help: (mock) Install asset from Marketplace (Launcher handoff).
commands.notes: Mock browser handoff flow exists; still not a real marketplace integration.

commands.short_help: List owned/installed marketplace assets.
commands.notes: Kurulu/owned listeyi lokal mock DB uzerinden gosterir.

commands.short_help: (mock) Search Unreal Engine Marketplace.
commands.notes: Gercek marketplace API yerine lokal mock DB ile simule eder.

commands.short_help: Migrate assets between projects.
commands.notes: Dosya kopyalar ama asset dependency/reference integrity kontrolu yapmaz.

commands.short_help: Migrate project to a new Unreal Engine version.
commands.notes: `EngineAssociation` dogrudan overwrite edilir; compatibility preflight yok.

commands.short_help: Scan project for optimization opportunities.
commands.notes: Acikca simulated work/result kullaniyor.

commands.short_help: Analyze and optimize texture memory usage.
commands.notes: Heuristic dosya boyutu kontrolu yapar; `--fix` adimi gercek texture pipeline entegrasyonu degil.

commands.short_help: Scan .umap files and estimate draw call sources.
commands.notes: Gercek draw call olcumu degil, dosya sayisina dayali tahmin tablosu.

commands.short_help: Audit memory usage and identify optimization opportunities.
commands.notes: Disk size * multiplier yaklasimi kullanir; runtime memory tahmini dogal olarak yaklasik.

commands.short_help: Scan C++ source for replicated UPROPERTY declarations.
commands.notes: Regex benzeri satir tarama ile replication audit; semantic parse yok.

commands.short_help: Analyze performance metrics and detect bottlenecks.
commands.notes: CSV profiling verisine dayali; veri yoksa sessizce no-data doner.

commands.short_help: Analyze shader complexity and optimization opportunities.
commands.notes: Kaynak dosya heuristic analizi; shader complexity UE compiler seviyesinde degil.

commands.short_help: Disable a plugin by editing the local .uproject file only.
commands.notes: .uproject only mutates locally; no plugin files are copied or deleted, and disable refuses missing entries instead of reporting a false success.

commands.short_help: Enable a plugin by editing the local .uproject file only.
commands.notes: .uproject only mutates locally; no plugin files are copied or deleted, and writes use an atomic temp-file replace.

commands.short_help: Clone or copy a plugin into the local Plugins directory.
commands.notes: Writes local Plugins/ state directly, does not edit .uproject automatically, has no rollback, and failed installs may leave partial local files behind.

commands.short_help: List all installed plugins.
commands.notes: Yerel `Plugins/**/*.uplugin` uzerinden listeler; cp1254 cikti riski mevcut.

commands.short_help: Delete a local plugin directory; .uproject cleanup stays manual.
commands.notes: Deletes only the local plugin directory, never cleans .uproject references automatically, and manual recovery may be required after filesystem failures.

commands.short_help: Launch the local interactive web dashboard.
commands.notes: Lifecycle adapter ile startup readiness/structured stop var; long-running runtime edge-case riski suruyor.

commands.short_help: Generate HTML project report with real stats.
commands.notes: Gercek dosya sayimlariyla rapor yazar; Unicode output/cp1254 riski suruyor.

commands.short_help: Export project stats as JSON (prints or saves to file).
commands.notes: JSON export var; panel ciktisi ve emoji kullanimi Windows legacy terminalde riskli.

commands.short_help: Log a local-only team notification.
commands.notes: Sadece lokal log yaziyor; `notification.webhook_url` schema ile uyumlu ama webhook gonderimi uygulanmis degil.

commands.short_help: Show usage analytics and metrics.
commands.notes: Sadece `~/.unrealmate/analytics.json` lokal verisini okur/yazar.

commands.short_help: Run interactive health checks for the project.
commands.notes: Gercek kontrol yapiyor ama spinner Unicode sebebiyle Windows cp1254 ortaminda calisma riski yuksek.

commands.short_help: Show project health score.
commands.notes: Health skoru placeholder metriklerle hesaplanir.

commands.short_help: Run security scan.
commands.notes: Dependency taramasi mock; gercek `pip-audit/safety` entegrasyonu yok.

commands.short_help: Show system and version information.
commands.notes: Minimal yan etki, dogrudan bilgi komutu.

commands.short_help: Create a new project from template.
commands.notes: Scaffold uretiyor; engine/module ayarlari template-agnostic degil.

commands.short_help: List available project templates.
commands.notes: Template listesi hardcoded; registry/discovery yok.

commands.short_help: Save current project as a re-usable template.
commands.notes: Yerel template kaydeder; 10MB ustu content dosyalari atlanir.
